content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am confused and was trying to follow the user manual, but it’s still unclear for the pure versions. I need help. I have a used [product_name] [version_no] (which is password protected), and a Brown memory card ([article_no]). I removed the password protection, so now I can transfer my program to the [product_name]. However: 1) How can I transfer a new program from the [product_name] to the memory card? Thank you for your help.

Hi, It’s not possible to transfer a program to a memory card using a [product_name] without display. You need a version with a display to program the card, and then you can load the program into the pure [product_name]. Refer to the older manual for more details. There are specific restrictions regarding which memory/battery cards can be used with which series of [product_name] devices.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced confusion due to unclear manual instructions when using a Brown memory card with a pure (no display) [product_name] module. The main usability insight is the difficulty in transferring data between the module and the memory card because of hardware limitations associated with the lack of a display. This points to documentation gaps, especially regarding compatibility and operational restrictions across different hardware variants.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear and straightforward instructions for transferring programs from a [product_name] (pure) module to the memory card, regardless of whether the device has a display.
